Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

Crafting

[edit | edit source]
Requirement Ingredients Crafting recipe
None
  •  1x Enchanted Brown Mushroom Block
  •  2x Feastfungus

Usage

[edit | edit source]

"Fragranced" Brown Mushroom "Paste" can be given to any Garden Visitor to scare them off and prevent them from appearing for 24h. A maximum of 2 visitors can be scared off at any given time.

Condition Dialogue
Giving any Visitor a
"Fragranced" Brown
Mushroom "Paste"
[NPC] <visitor>: YUCK!! What is this??
